# YINSU Flame Retardant

> YINSU is a leading manufacturer and supplier of flame retardant masterbatches, powders, and chemical additives for industrial applications across automotive, textiles, plastics, and construction.

YINSU specializes in innovative flame retardant solutions including red phosphorus, bromine-based products, and antimony replacements. The company serves multiple industries with material-specific formulations and high-functional additives designed to meet fire safety standards.

## Key Topics

- Red Phosphorus Flame Retardant
- Bromine Flame Retardant
- Antimony Flame Retardant Replacement
- Phosphorus Nitrogen Flame Retardant
- Charcoal-forming Agent
- High Functional Additive
- Nano Organic Montmorillonite (OMMT)
- Flame Retardant Masterbatch
- Bromine Antimony Replacement Agent
- Fire Safety Compliance
- Polymer Additives
- Industrial Chemicals
- Material-Specific Solutions
- Chemical Additives
- Flame Retardant Powder
